faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions & How It Works
faq.subtitle: Essential knowledge regarding land deed cryptographic verification and fraud prevention
faq.q1: How does pre-purchase verification prevent double-sale fraud?
faq.a1: Ed25519 digital signatures and SHA-256 ledger hash chains verify historical deeds against the plot. If the land was previously transferred to someone else, LandShield instantly flags the double sale before you pay.
faq.q2: Why is land mutation critical after deed registration?
faq.a2: Mutation officially updates the governmental record of rights (Khatian). If a deed remains unmutated beyond 90 days, the AI Rules Engine flags it as a moderate risk to prevent unauthorized secondary resales.
faq.q3: What happens if deed payload contents are tampered with?
faq.a3: If even a single character, date, or acreage in the deed is modified, SHA-256 hash validation and the Sub-Registrar's Ed25519 signature fail, triggering an immediate red TAMPERED alert.
faq.q4: Is citizen pre-purchase inspection free and public?
faq.a4: Yes, citizen deed verification and plot risk checks are 100% public, instant, and free—no login required. Simply enter a Dag number or scan the QR code printed on the deed.
